Pillars: from an adjacent tile you can attack the Blessings pots on top — 2 damage breaks one (2 coin, 1 CF, a hidden offering). Push a pillar (2 movement) onto a tunnel to seal it, or topple it (3 movement): the next two tiles take 3 damage and every pot breaks.

Tunnels: 1 Arena Key takes you underground. You choose the exit tunnel, your turn ends, and you surface there at the start of your next turn — untouchable while underground. A gladiator standing on a tunnel is fair game. A pillar pushed onto a tunnel seals it.
Floor spikes: entering this tile deals 2 damage. Push rivals and beasts onto them.
The Arena Chest: 1 Arena Key opens it for a level-4 weapon. You can also pick it up and carry it (−1 movement while held).
Dropped gear: standing on it, you may loot 1 item a turn (thrown weapons are always free to pick up).
An offering in the sand: step on it to pick it up.
Move: straight steps cost 1 movement, diagonals 2. Orange tiles show where you can go and what it costs.
Push (2 movement): shove an adjacent pillar, gladiator or beast one tile away — onto spikes, or a pillar onto a tunnel.
Tunnel (1 Arena Key): go underground and surface at another open tunnel. Ends your turn.
Open the Arena Chest (1 Arena Key): take a level-4 weapon.
Pick up the chest: −1 movement while you carry it.
Drop the chest where you stand. Free.
Loot: take one item from the gear at your feet this turn.
Crowd Favor: spend CF on keys, cards, elixirs and armor. Never let it fall below 0 — you would be eliminated.
